climate.description: Late September in Polish Tatras brings mild 50-68°F days but mountain mood swings with rain, fog, and wind. Crisp air sharpens suffering on climbs. Pack layers; weather gods don't care about your Strava KOM.

terrain.surface: Paved road course through Zakopane and the surrounding Tatra region
features: Repeated climbing totaling 1,600 m on the flagship course

fondo_rating.scoring_notes: Corrected to the official completed 2026 flagship course: 107 km / 1,600 m. Distance rises to 4; climbing is 3 and altitude 1 because the route is not a high-altitude event. Score recalculates to 67.

course_description.character: The completed 2026 Race covered 107 km with 1,600 m of climbing from Zakopane. Its training demand comes from repeated climbing on paved Tatra roads while maintaining efficient group position between the harder efforts. The separate 51 km Ride carried 900 m of climbing.
course_description.signature_challenge: Accumulating 1,600 m of climbing across the 107 km competitive course

logistics.airport: Kraków John Paul II (KRK) 100km/2hrs north—budget flights galore. No Zakopane airstrip; trains/buses fill gaps. Rent cars for Tatra freedom.
logistics.lodging_strategy: Book Zakopane resorts early—peak season crush. Guesthouses abound; aim central for Tadeusza Kościuszki start. Shoulder season pricing sweet.
logistics.transport: Zakopane is reached overland from Kraków; confirm next-edition start, parking, and road-closure instructions before booking.
logistics.food: Pierogi power and mountain hearty fare. Zakopane's tourist scene delivers cyclist fuel. Post-race oscypek cheese rewards suffering.

history.origin_story: Born 2024, L'Etape Poland imports Tour de France sizzle to Poland's Tatra crown. ASO blesses BE COOL's vision, partnering Zakopane for mountain mecca. First edition tests appetite for branded suffering amid Polish peaks. Instant family affair with kids races.
history.reputation: Fresh-faced phenom borrowing TdF glow. Early buzz solid from pro touches. Poised to own Eastern gran fondo scene.

biased_opinion.summary: L'Étape Poland brings a Tour de France-branded mass-participation race to Zakopane. The completed second edition paired a 107 km / 1,600 m competitive course with a shorter 51 km Ride and family events. It is a legitimate climbing race, but its next plan suite must wait for an organizer-confirmed 2027 date and course.
biased_opinion.bottom_line: Bucket-list for mountain lovers seeking branded pain without Alps prices. Prestige accelerates growth trajectory. Race it before crowds swarm.

final_verdict.one_liner: A 107 km / 1,600 m competitive L'Étape course based in Zakopane.
final_verdict.should_you_race: Race it if you want a medium-length climbing event with Tour de France presentation in the Polish Tatras. Wait for the organizer to publish the next edition before booking or starting a date-specific plan.
final_verdict.alternatives: Unreal Haute Route Poland for multi-day Tatras, Transcontinental Poland qualifiers for ultra-adventure, or classic Etape du Tour France for OG suffering.
